offers.description: Define the offers and Items to be used. Use an array if adding multiple Item and Offer combinations. This includes Upsells. Offers will be required on this method if there are not any existing offers on the order.

id.description: A unique identifier for the particular offer for the order. This value is generated by you and used to allow orders to have the same offer on an order more than once.

item_id.description: Vrio item id to be used with the offer_id. Required for shared offers.

order_offer_price.description: Override the configured offer price with a different price that will be used on the initial charge.

order_offer_shipping.description: Override the configured offer level shipping price with a different price that will be used on the initial charge.

discount_code.description: Discount code to be applied to this offer.

order_offer_item_options.description: When an Item has options, or variants, determine which options should be applied. Each option will have a subset option value. Example: size is an option, Small - Medium - Large is the option value. Required for items that have options.

item_option_value_id.description: The value to be used for the item option ID passed.

override_initial_item_id.description: Pass an Item ID that will be used for the initial only, ths order will then use the item_id passed for all subsequent transactions. See here for additional use cases.

override_initial_item_options.description: When  using an override_initial_item_id and the item has options, or variants, determine which options should be applied. Each option will have a subset option value. Required with override item has options.

item_option_id.description: The option to be applied to the override_initial_item_id.

item_option_value_id.description: The value to be used for the override_initial_item_id.

order_offer_upsell.description: Mark true if this order offer should be flagged as an upsell. This is important for reporting.

order_offer_upsell_weight.description: This can be used to define the order of upsell. Pass 1 for the first upsell, 2 for the second, etc.

parent_order_offer_id.description: The parent_order_offer_id is referencing the specific order offer that the upsell was derived from. This would be available if an order was created and an offer was added to it, then you wanted to add an offer to it at a later date. Required when passing order_offer_upsell and not passing a parent_offer_id and parent_order_id.

parent_offer_id.description: The parent_offer_id is what is passed when the parent_order_offer_id is not available. This would commonly be used when you create an order all at one time.. Required when passing order_offer_upsell and not passing a parent_order_offer_id.

parent_order_id.description: The id of the original order, used to add an order offer as upsell from a different order.. Required when passing order_offer_upsell and not passing a parent_order_offer_id.

status_type_id.description:
This can be used to define the status of an upsell. If not passed, Vrio will define statuses. Accepted values are : 
* `7` - Rejected
* `8` - Removed

is_gift.description: If true, gift logic will apply to this order.

gift_message.description: Message to use for gift communication. Required if is_gift is true.

gift_date.description: Date to send gift communication. Required if is_gift is true.

gift_name.description: Name for the person receiving the gift. Required if is_gift is true.

gift_email.description: Email for the person receiving the gift. Required if is_gift is true.

gift_phone.description: Phone for the person receiving the gift. Required if is_gift is true.

offers_restrict.description: When passing offers, use this flag to mark all the existing order offers as Removed.

campaign_id.description: Associate order with a new campaign.

force_campaign_id.description: If there is a campaign already on the order, pass this flag in conjunction with a campaign_id to change it to a new campaign. All campaign configurations will be used with the new campaign_id. Required when passing a campaign_id.

customers_address_billing_id.description: A billing address is required to process an order. Either passing an an address id or creating a new address with the bill_ fields.

customers_address_shipping_id.description: A shipping address is required to process an order that has a shippable item. Either passing an an address id or creating a new address with the ship_ fields.

bill_fname.description: Billing first name. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty.

bill_lname.description: Billing last name. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty.

bill_address1.description: Billing address line 1. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty.

bill_city.description: Billing city. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty.

bill_country.description: Billing country code, 2 letters (example : US). Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty.

bill_state.description: Billing state. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty and bill_county is US or CA.

bill_zipcode.description: Billing zipcode. Required when customers_address_billing_id is empty

same_address.description: Pass as true to use the same address for billing and shipping. Only one of those is required in that case.

ship_fname.description: Shipping first name. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

ship_lname.description: Shipping last name. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

ship_address1.description: Shipping address line 1. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

ship_city.description: Shipping city. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

ship_country.description: Shipping country code, 2 letters (example : US). Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

ship_state.description: Shipping state. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items and ship_country is US or CA.

ship_zipcode.description: Shipping zipcode. Required when customers_address_shipping_id is empty and order has shippable items.

shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile to be used to determine shipping logic. Required if shipping profiles are setup on the campaign and there are shippable items on the order.
